p0: The process of individually classifying each item through a fresh human judgment.
p1: The process of extracting and explicitly formulating a general classification rule from repeated individual classifications.
emergence_rationale: Repeated individual classifications reveal a recurring criterion.
potential_rationale: The criterion being formalized already exists implicitly in the repeated individual judgments.
determinacy_rationale: Formulating the rule makes explicit the previously implicit logic of the individual judgments.
